purpose: Defined productivity methods, measurable work quality, workload, fatigue, access, and organizational conditions.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Specify role, task, comparator, time, and outcome. Distinguish anecdotes from evidence, include fatigue and structural constraints, protect worker privacy, and give no personal medical advice.
